media.title: The Brooklyn Citizen, 18 June 1937 — A Day at the Races cast and credits
media.description: Cast-and-credits listing for the MGM film A Day at the Races (1937) in The Brooklyn Citizen, 18 June 1937 (p. 14). The notice gives music by Bronisław Kaper and Walter Jurmann, lyrics by Gus Kahn, direction by Sam Wood, MGM production context, and cast headed by the Marx Brothers, Allan Jones, Maureen O'Sullivan and Margaret Dumont. Source: SRC0114.
